summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo (uncommitted). Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py with Tab, TabsRenderable, and Tabs; UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and now yields one Text with click spans; Opacity merges the blended color into the existing style so metadata is kept; layout resolver needed no change because its Edge protocol already declares size, min_size, and fraction. Added tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py (appended, imports added) and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py, plus docs/reference/tabs.md and sandbox/tabs_demo.py with tabs_demo.css. Nothing was run: per instructions, verification was by reading only. Deliberate choices: Right/Left skip tabs that share the active name to avoid getting stuck on duplicates; the bar position (a full-list index) is mapped to displayed tabs by name; letter search only applies to single-character keys; empty labels get a one-cell label edge. Known limitation: Escape calls app.set_focus(None) without await, as specified, so it does not remove focus and emits a never-awaited coroutine warning.
